name: attachments
title: Attachments
description: AttachmentStrip: a horizontally scrolling strip of image thumbnails and file chips (icon, name, type and size). Images open a Lightbox, files open their link, max adds a +N button. AttachmentThumb renders one. Agents get openAttachment(id).
docs: Each attachment is { id, name, kind: "image" | "file", src, srcDark?, thumbnail?, thumbnailDark?, alt, href?, size?, mimeType? }. Dark variants are rendered beside the light ones and CSS shows the one that matches the theme (`.dark`, or the system preference unless the page opted into light), so there is no flash. `onOpen(attachment, details)` runs before anything opens, for people and agents (`details.source === "agent"`); `details.cancel()` keeps it closed. Sizes are formatted with Intl in `locale`. The strip needs an `aria-label`; the other labels are English and overridable through `labels` (`open`, `more`, `lightbox`). Focus returns to the thumbnail that opened the lightbox.
